page_content:
Table: attendance

Domain: Human Resources (HR)

Description:
Stores daily employee attendance records, including working hours and attendance status.

Business Purpose:
- Track employee presence and absence
- Monitor working hours and punctuality
- Generate attendance reports
- Support payroll and leave management

Columns:
- attendance_id: Unique identifier for an attendance record
- employee_id: Employee associated with the attendance record
- attendance_date: Date of attendance
- check_in: Employee check-in time
- check_out: Employee check-out time
- status: Attendance status such as present, absent, late, half_day, or holiday

Relationships:
- employee_id references employees.employee_id

Common Queries:
- Employee attendance report
- Attendance percentage by employee
- Employees absent on a specific date
- Late arrivals analysis
- Monthly attendance summary
- Working hours calculation

Business Insights:
- Identify employees with frequent absences
- Track punctuality trends
- Measure workforce availability
- Support HR compliance and payroll processing

Table: brands

Domain: Product Management

Description:
Stores information about product brands or manufacturers.

Business Purpose:
- Organize products by brand
- Support brand-wise sales analysis
- Track manufacturer information
- Enable product categorization and reporting

Columns:
- brand_id: Unique identifier for a brand
- brand_name: Name of the brand or manufacturer
- country: Country where the brand originates

Relationships:
- Referenced by products.brand_id

Common Queries:
- Products belonging to a specific brand
- Revenue generated by each brand
- Top selling brands
- Brand-wise inventory analysis
- Brands by country

Business Insights:
- Identify best performing brands
- Compare brand sales performance
- Analyze inventory distribution by brand
- Evaluate product portfolio across manufacturers

Table: categories

Domain: Product Management

Description:
Stores product categories used to classify products into different business segments.

Business Purpose:
- Organize products into logical groups
- Enable category-wise sales analysis
- Support inventory management by category
- Improve product search and reporting

Columns:
- category_id: Unique identifier for a product category
- category_name: Name of the category
- description: Additional details about the category

Relationships:
- Referenced by products.category_id

Common Queries:
- Products in a specific category
- Revenue generated by category
- Top selling categories
- Inventory distribution by category
- Category-wise product count

Business Insights:
- Identify high-performing product categories
- Analyze sales trends across categories
- Monitor inventory allocation by category
- Understand product portfolio distribution

Table: customer_addresses

Domain: sales

Description:
Stores address information associated with customers. A customer can have multiple addresses, including billing and shipping locations.

Business Purpose:
- Maintain customer address records
- Support order delivery and shipping operations
- Enable customer location analysis
- Manage default customer addresses

Columns:
- address_id: Unique identifier for a customer address
- customer_id: Customer associated with the address
- address_line: Street address or address details
- city: City of the customer address
- state: State or region of the customer address
- country: Country of the customer address
- postal_code: Postal or ZIP code of the address
- is_default: Indicates whether this is the default address for the customer

Relationships:
- customer_id references customers.customer_id

Common Queries:
- Show addresses for a customer
- Find customers by city or state
- Retrieve default address for a customer
- Customer distribution by location
- Shipping address lookup

Business Insights:
- Analyze customer geographic distribution
- Identify regions with the highest customer concentration
- Support logistics and delivery planning
- Improve customer segmentation based on location

Table: customers

Domain: sales

Description:
Stores customer master information, including personal details, contact information, account status, and customer classification.

Business Purpose:
- Maintain customer records
- Support sales and order management
- Enable customer segmentation
- Track customer lifecycle and engagement
- Support customer relationship management

Columns:
- customer_id: Unique identifier for a customer
- first_name: Customer's first name
- last_name: Customer's last name
- email: Unique email address of the customer
- phone: Customer contact number
- registration_date: Date when the customer registered
- customer_type: Category of customer such as retail, wholesale, or vip
- status: Current customer account status

Relationships:
- Referenced by customer_addresses.customer_id
- Referenced by sales_orders.customer_id
- Referenced by support_tickets.customer_id

Common Queries:
- Show all active customers
- Top customers by revenue
- Customers registered in a specific period
- Customer segmentation by type
- Customer count by status
- Customer purchase history

Business Insights:
- Identify high-value customers
- Analyze customer growth trends
- Compare retail, wholesale, and VIP customer performance
- Measure customer retention and engagement
- Understand customer distribution across segments

Table: departments

Domain: hr

Description:
Stores information about organizational departments, including department budgets, locations, and administrative details.

Business Purpose:
- Organize employees into functional units
- Manage departmental budgets
- Track department locations
- Support workforce planning and resource allocation
- Enable department-wise reporting and analytics

Columns:
- department_id: Unique identifier for a department
- department_name: Name of the department
- budget: Allocated budget for the department
- location: Physical location of the department
- created_at: Timestamp when the department record was created

Relationships:
- Referenced by employees.department_id
- Referenced by projects.department_id

Common Queries:
- Show all departments
- Department budget analysis
- Employee count by department
- Departments by location
- Budget allocation across departments
- Department performance reports

Business Insights:
- Compare departmental budget utilization
- Analyze workforce distribution across departments
- Identify departments with the largest workforce
- Support strategic resource planning
- Measure department-level operational performance

Table: employees

Domain: hr

Description:
Stores employee master information, including personal details, employment information, reporting hierarchy, compensation, and organizational assignment.

Business Purpose:
- Maintain employee records
- Manage organizational hierarchy
- Track employee compensation and designations
- Support payroll, attendance, and leave management
- Enable workforce planning and HR analytics

Columns:
- employee_id: Unique identifier for an employee
- department_id: Department to which the employee belongs
- manager_id: Reporting manager of the employee
- first_name: Employee's first name
- last_name: Employee's last name
- email: Unique employee email address
- phone: Employee contact number
- salary: Employee salary amount
- designation: Job title or designation of the employee
- hire_date: Date when the employee joined the organization
- status: Employment status such as active, inactive, on_leave, or terminated

Relationships:
- department_id references departments.department_id
- manager_id references employees.employee_id (self-referencing hierarchy)
- Referenced by attendance.employee_id
- Referenced by leaves.employee_id
- Referenced by payroll.employee_id
- Referenced by support_tickets.assigned_employee_id
- Referenced by projects.project_manager_id
- Referenced by tasks.assigned_to

Common Queries:
- Show all active employees
- Employees by department
- Employee salary analysis
- Organization hierarchy report
- Employees under a specific manager
- Average salary by department
- Employee count by designation
- Recent hires and workforce growth

Business Insights:
- Analyze workforce distribution across departments
- Identify reporting structures and management chains
- Measure salary distribution across designations
- Evaluate employee retention and turnover trends
- Support workforce planning and HR decision-making
- Identify high-cost and high-performing organizational units

Table: inventory

Domain: inventory

Description:
Stores inventory stock levels for products across warehouses. This table tracks product availability, stock replenishment requirements, and inventory status at each warehouse location.

Business Purpose:
- Track available product inventory
- Monitor stock levels across warehouses
- Support inventory replenishment planning
- Prevent stock shortages and overstocking
- Enable warehouse inventory management

Columns:
- inventory_id: Unique identifier for an inventory record
- warehouse_id: Warehouse where the inventory is stored
- product_id: Product associated with the inventory record
- quantity_available: Current quantity available in stock
- reorder_level: Minimum stock level before replenishment is required
- last_updated: Timestamp of the latest inventory update

Relationships:
- warehouse_id references warehouses.warehouse_id
- product_id references products.product_id

Common Queries:
- Products below reorder level
- Current stock availability by warehouse
- Inventory status for a product
- Low stock alerts
- Warehouse-wise inventory summary
- Product stock distribution across warehouses
- Inventory valuation reports

Business Insights:
- Identify products at risk of stockout
- Monitor inventory health across warehouses
- Optimize inventory replenishment cycles
- Analyze warehouse stock utilization
- Improve supply chain planning and inventory control
- Detect slow-moving and fast-moving inventory items

Table: invoices

Domain: finance

Description:
Stores invoice records generated from customer sales orders. This table tracks billing information, invoice status, payment obligations, and outstanding receivables.

Business Purpose:
- Generate billing records for sales orders
- Track customer payment obligations
- Monitor outstanding receivables
- Support revenue recognition and financial reporting
- Manage invoice lifecycle and payment collection

Columns:
- invoice_id: Unique identifier for an invoice
- sales_order_id: Sales order associated with the invoice
- invoice_date: Date when the invoice was generated
- due_date: Payment due date for the invoice
- amount: Total invoice amount
- status: Current invoice status such as draft, sent, paid, overdue, or cancelled

Relationships:
- sales_order_id references sales_orders.sales_order_id
- Referenced by payments.invoice_id

Common Queries:
- Outstanding invoices
- Overdue invoices
- Paid invoices
- Invoice status summary
- Revenue generated by invoices
- Invoices due within a specific period
- Customer receivables report

Business Insights:
- Monitor accounts receivable performance
- Identify overdue payment trends
- Track invoice collection efficiency
- Analyze revenue recognition patterns
- Measure payment compliance and customer credit behavior
- Support financial planning and cash flow forecasting

Table: leaves

Domain: hr

Description:
Stores employee leave requests and leave history. This table tracks leave types, leave periods, approval status, and reasons for employee absences.

Business Purpose:
- Manage employee leave requests
- Track employee absences and leave balances
- Support leave approval workflows
- Assist payroll and attendance processing
- Enable workforce availability planning

Columns:
- leave_id: Unique identifier for a leave request
- employee_id: Employee requesting the leave
- leave_type: Type of leave such as casual, sick, earned, maternity, paternity, or unpaid
- start_date: Leave start date
- end_date: Leave end date
- status: Current leave request status such as pending, approved, rejected, or cancelled
- reason: Reason provided for the leave request

Relationships:
- employee_id references employees.employee_id

Common Queries:
- Pending leave requests
- Approved leaves by employee
- Employees on leave during a specific period
- Leave history of an employee
- Leave utilization by department
- Leave count by leave type
- Upcoming employee absences

Business Insights:
- Analyze leave patterns across the organization
- Identify departments with high absenteeism
- Monitor leave utilization trends
- Support workforce scheduling and resource planning
- Evaluate employee well-being and attendance behavior
- Improve leave policy management and compliance

Table: payments

Domain: finance

Description:
Stores payment transactions made against invoices. This table records payment amounts, payment methods, transaction references, and payment dates to support financial operations and receivables management.

Business Purpose:
- Record customer payments
- Track invoice settlements
- Support financial reconciliation
- Monitor payment collection performance
- Enable cash flow and revenue analysis

Columns:
- payment_id: Unique identifier for a payment transaction
- invoice_id: Invoice associated with the payment
- payment_method: Method used for payment such as cash, card, upi, bank_transfer, or wallet
- payment_date: Date when the payment was received
- amount: Amount paid by the customer
- transaction_reference: Reference number or identifier for the transaction

Relationships:
- invoice_id references invoices.invoice_id

Common Queries:
- Payments received within a date range
- Payments by payment method
- Invoice payment history
- Total payments collected
- Daily payment collection report
- Payment reconciliation report
- Outstanding invoices without payments

Business Insights:
- Analyze customer payment behavior
- Measure payment collection efficiency
- Track preferred payment methods
- Monitor cash inflows and revenue realization
- Identify delayed payment patterns
- Support financial auditing and reconciliation processes

Table: payroll

Domain: hr

Description:
Stores employee salary and payroll records for each payroll period. This table tracks salary components, bonuses, deductions, net salary, and payroll payment information.

Business Purpose:
- Manage employee payroll processing
- Track salary payments and compensation history
- Support financial and HR reporting
- Monitor payroll expenses
- Enable compensation analysis and workforce cost management

Columns:
- payroll_id: Unique identifier for a payroll record
- employee_id: Employee associated with the payroll record
- month: Payroll month
- year: Payroll year
- basic_salary: Employee's base salary for the payroll period
- bonus: Additional compensation paid to the employee
- deductions: Amount deducted from salary
- net_salary: Final salary paid after applying bonuses and deductions
- payment_date: Date when salary was paid

Relationships:
- employee_id references employees.employee_id

Common Queries:
- Employee salary history
- Monthly payroll reports
- Payroll expenses by department
- Employees paid in a specific month
- Bonus and deduction analysis
- Average salary by designation
- Total payroll cost for a period

Business Insights:
- Analyze payroll expenditure trends
- Compare compensation across departments and designations
- Monitor workforce cost over time
- Identify departments with highest payroll expenses
- Support budgeting and financial planning
- Evaluate compensation structure effectiveness

Table: permissions

Domain: security

Description:
Stores system permissions that define specific actions or access rights available within the application. Permissions are used to control what users can view, create, update, delete, or manage.

Business Purpose:
- Define system access controls
- Support role-based access management
- Restrict unauthorized actions
- Improve application security and governance
- Enable permission-based authorization

Columns:
- permission_id: Unique identifier for a permission
- permission_name: Unique name of the permission
- description: Description of the access right or capability

Relationships:
- Referenced by role_permissions.permission_id

Common Queries:
- List all available permissions
- Permissions assigned to a role
- Search permissions by name
- Audit available access rights
- Permission coverage analysis

Business Insights:
- Analyze access control structure
- Identify unused or redundant permissions
- Support security audits and compliance reviews
- Improve governance and authorization management
- Ensure proper segregation of duties within the system

Table: products

Domain: product_management

Description:
Stores master information about products sold or managed by the organization. This table contains product details, pricing information, inventory indicators, brand associations, and category classifications.

Business Purpose:
- Maintain product catalog information
- Manage product pricing and profitability
- Support inventory and warehouse operations
- Enable sales and procurement activities
- Facilitate product performance analysis

Columns:
- product_id: Unique identifier for a product
- category_id: Category to which the product belongs
- brand_id: Brand associated with the product
- sku: Unique stock keeping unit identifier
- product_name: Name of the product
- description: Detailed description of the product
- cost_price: Cost incurred to acquire or manufacture the product
- selling_price: Price at which the product is sold
- stock_quantity: Current available stock quantity
- created_at: Timestamp when the product record was created

Relationships:
- category_id references categories.category_id
- brand_id references brands.brand_id
- Referenced by inventory.product_id
- Referenced by purchase_order_items.product_id
- Referenced by sales_order_items.product_id
- Referenced by shipment_items.product_id

Common Queries:
- Product catalog listing
- Products by category
- Products by brand
- Product profitability analysis
- Inventory status by product
- Best selling products
- Low stock products
- Product revenue analysis
- Product margin analysis

Business Insights:
- Identify top-performing products
- Analyze product profitability and margins
- Monitor inventory turnover
- Compare performance across brands and categories
- Detect slow-moving and fast-moving products
- Support pricing and procurement decisions
- Optimize product portfolio management

Table: projects

Domain: project_management

Description:
Stores information about organizational projects, including project ownership, budget allocation, timelines, and project status. This table is used to track projects managed by employees and monitor project execution.

Business Purpose:
- Manage organizational projects
- Track project budgets and timelines
- Monitor project progress and status
- Support resource allocation and planning
- Enable project performance analysis

Columns:
- project_id: Unique identifier for a project
- employee_id: Employee responsible for managing the project
- project_name: Name of the project
- budget: Allocated budget for the project
- start_date: Project start date
- end_date: Planned or actual project completion date
- status: Current project status such as planned, active, on_hold, completed, or cancelled

Relationships:
- employee_id references employees.employee_id
- Referenced by tasks.project_id

Common Queries:
- Active projects
- Projects managed by an employee
- Project budget analysis
- Completed projects
- Projects by status
- Projects ending within a specific period
- Budget utilization by project
- Project performance reports
- Employee project workload analysis

Business Insights:
- Monitor project success and completion rates
- Analyze project budget allocation
- Identify delayed or stalled projects
- Measure project workload distribution among employees
- Support resource planning and project forecasting
- Evaluate project portfolio performance

Table: purchase_order_items

Domain: procurement

Description:
Stores individual line items associated with purchase orders. Each record represents a product being procured, along with quantity, unit price, and subtotal amount. This table enables detailed tracking of procurement transactions.

Business Purpose:
- Record products included in purchase orders
- Track procurement quantities and costs
- Calculate purchase order totals
- Support supplier spending analysis
- Enable procurement and inventory reporting

Columns:
- purchase_order_item_id: Unique identifier for a purchase order item
- purchase_order_id: Purchase order associated with the item
- product_id: Product being procured
- quantity: Quantity of the product ordered
- unit_price: Purchase price per unit
- subtotal: Total amount for the line item (quantity Ã— unit_price)

Relationships:
- purchase_order_id references purchase_orders.purchase_order_id
- product_id references products.product_id

Common Queries:
- Products purchased from suppliers
- Purchase order details
- Procurement spending by product
- Quantity purchased by product
- Purchase order cost breakdown
- Supplier procurement analysis
- Most frequently purchased products
- Product procurement trends

Business Insights:
- Analyze procurement costs by product
- Identify high-volume purchased products
- Monitor supplier purchasing patterns
- Support inventory replenishment planning
- Evaluate procurement efficiency and spending trends
- Improve purchasing decisions through cost analysis

Table: purchase_orders

Domain: procurement

Description:
Stores purchase orders issued to suppliers for procuring products and inventory. This table tracks supplier orders, delivery expectations, procurement status, and total purchasing costs.

Business Purpose:
- Manage procurement transactions with suppliers
- Track purchase order lifecycle
- Monitor supplier deliveries
- Support inventory replenishment processes
- Enable procurement cost and spending analysis

Columns:
- purchase_order_id: Unique identifier for a purchase order
- supplier_id: Supplier associated with the purchase order
- order_date: Date when the purchase order was created
- expected_delivery: Expected delivery date from the supplier
- status: Current purchase order status such as draft, placed, partially_received, received, or cancelled
- total_amount: Total monetary value of the purchase order

Relationships:
- supplier_id references suppliers.supplier_id
- Referenced by purchase_order_items.purchase_order_id

Common Queries:
- Purchase orders by supplier
- Pending purchase orders
- Received purchase orders
- Procurement spending by supplier
- Purchase orders awaiting delivery
- Monthly procurement analysis
- Supplier order history
- Purchase order status reports
- Procurement cost trends

Business Insights:
- Analyze supplier spending patterns
- Monitor procurement efficiency and delivery performance
- Identify suppliers with delayed deliveries
- Track procurement costs over time
- Support inventory planning and replenishment
- Evaluate supplier reliability and purchasing trends

Table: role_permissions

Domain: security

Description:
Stores the mapping between roles and permissions in the role-based access control (RBAC) system. Each record defines which permission is assigned to a specific role.

Business Purpose:
- Implement role-based access control
- Assign permissions to roles
- Manage user authorization policies
- Support application security and governance
- Simplify permission management through roles

Columns:
- role_id: Role associated with the permission
- permission_id: Permission assigned to the role

Relationships:
- role_id references roles.role_id
- permission_id references permissions.permission_id

Common Queries:
- Permissions assigned to a role
- Roles having a specific permission
- Complete role-permission matrix
- Access control audit reports
- Security configuration reviews
- Permission coverage analysis

Business Insights:
- Analyze access control structure across the organization
- Identify over-privileged roles
- Detect missing permissions for critical roles
- Support security audits and compliance checks
- Improve governance through centralized authorization management
- Ensure proper segregation of duties and access policies

Table: roles

Domain: security

Description:
Stores user roles used in the role-based access control (RBAC) system. Roles represent collections of permissions that define what actions users can perform within the application.

Business Purpose:
- Define access levels within the system
- Simplify permission management
- Support role-based access control
- Enforce security policies and governance
- Manage authorization across users and departments

Columns:
- role_id: Unique identifier for a role
- role_name: Unique name of the role
- description: Description of the role and its responsibilities
- created_at: Timestamp when the role was created

Relationships:
- Referenced by role_permissions.role_id
- Referenced by users.role_id

Common Queries:
- List all roles
- Permissions assigned to a role
- Users belonging to a role
- Role hierarchy analysis
- Access control audit reports
- Role-based authorization reviews

Business Insights:
- Analyze role distribution across users
- Identify unused or redundant roles
- Support security audits and compliance reviews
- Evaluate access control effectiveness
- Improve governance through standardized role management
- Ensure proper segregation of duties and access privileges

Table: sales_order_items

Domain: sales

Description:
Stores individual line items associated with customer sales orders. Each record represents a product sold within an order, including quantity, selling price, and subtotal amount. This table provides detailed transaction-level sales data.

Business Purpose:
- Record products sold in customer orders
- Track sales quantities and revenue at product level
- Calculate order totals
- Support sales analytics and reporting
- Enable product performance analysis

Columns:
- sales_order_item_id: Unique identifier for a sales order item
- sales_order_id: Sales order associated with the item
- product_id: Product sold in the order
- quantity: Quantity of the product sold
- unit_price: Selling price per unit
- subtotal: Total amount for the line item (quantity Ã— unit_price)

Relationships:
- sales_order_id references sales_orders.sales_order_id
- product_id references products.product_id

Common Queries:
- Products sold in a sales order
- Revenue by product
- Best-selling products
- Sales quantity by product
- Order value breakdown
- Product sales trends
- Top revenue-generating products
- Monthly sales analysis
- Product performance reports

Business Insights:
- Identify best-selling products
- Analyze product revenue contribution
- Measure product demand trends
- Evaluate product profitability when combined with cost data
- Support inventory forecasting based on sales patterns
- Detect seasonal demand fluctuations
- Improve pricing and product portfolio decisions

Table: sales_orders

Domain: sales

Description:
Stores customer sales orders placed through the business. This table tracks order information, customer purchases, order lifecycle status, payment status, and total order value.

Business Purpose:
- Manage customer purchase transactions
- Track order fulfillment lifecycle
- Monitor payment collection status
- Support revenue and sales analysis
- Enable customer order history tracking

Columns:
- sales_order_id: Unique identifier for a sales order
- customer_id: Customer who placed the order
- order_date: Date when the order was placed
- status: Current order status such as pending, confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered, or cancelled
- payment_status: Payment status such as unpaid, partial, paid, or refunded
- total_amount: Total monetary value of the order

Relationships:
- customer_id references customers.customer_id
- Referenced by sales_order_items.sales_order_id
- Referenced by invoices.sales_order_id
- Referenced by shipments.sales_order_id

Common Queries:
- Orders placed by a customer
- Orders within a date range
- Pending and delivered orders
- Revenue generated from sales orders
- Customer purchase history
- Order status analysis
- Payment status reports
- Monthly sales trends
- Top customers by revenue
- Average order value analysis

Business Insights:
- Analyze sales performance over time
- Identify high-value customers
- Monitor order fulfillment efficiency
- Track revenue growth trends
- Measure payment collection effectiveness
- Identify cancelled order patterns
- Support sales forecasting and business planning

Table: shipment_items

Domain: logistics

Description:
Stores the individual products included in a shipment. Each record represents a product and quantity being shipped as part of a customer order fulfillment process.

Business Purpose:
- Track products included in shipments
- Support order fulfillment operations
- Monitor quantities shipped to customers
- Enable shipment tracking and logistics reporting
- Validate shipment completeness against sales orders

Columns:
- shipment_item_id: Unique identifier for a shipment item
- shipment_id: Shipment associated with the product being shipped
- product_id: Product included in the shipment
- quantity: Quantity of the product shipped

Relationships:
- shipment_id references shipments.shipment_id
- product_id references products.product_id

Connected Business Entities:
- Shipments
- Products
- Sales Orders
- Customers

Common Queries:
- Products included in a shipment
- Quantity shipped by product
- Shipment contents report
- Product shipment history
- Most frequently shipped products
- Shipment fulfillment analysis
- Products shipped within a date range
- Product distribution across shipments

Business Insights:
- Analyze shipment volumes by product
- Identify high-demand products based on shipment frequency
- Monitor fulfillment accuracy and completeness
- Track product movement through the logistics network
- Support inventory and replenishment planning
- Improve warehouse and shipping efficiency

Table: shipments

Domain: logistics

Description:
Stores shipment records associated with customer sales orders. This table tracks shipping activities, delivery progress, shipment status, and carrier information throughout the order fulfillment lifecycle.

Business Purpose:
- Manage order shipment operations
- Track delivery progress and shipment status
- Support logistics and fulfillment processes
- Monitor carrier performance
- Enable customer delivery tracking

Columns:
- shipment_id: Unique identifier for a shipment
- sales_order_id: Sales order associated with the shipment
- shipment_date: Date when the shipment was dispatched
- delivery_date: Date when the shipment was delivered
- status: Current shipment status such as pending, shipped, in_transit, delivered, returned, or cancelled
- carrier: Shipping carrier or logistics provider

Relationships:
- sales_order_id references sales_orders.sales_order_id
- Referenced by shipment_items.shipment_id

Connected Business Entities:
- Sales Orders
- Customers
- Products
- Shipment Items

Common Queries:
- Shipments by order
- Pending deliveries
- Delivered shipments
- Shipment status tracking
- Carrier performance analysis
- Orders currently in transit
- Delivery turnaround time analysis
- Returned shipment reports

Business Insights:
- Monitor delivery performance and fulfillment efficiency
- Analyze carrier reliability
- Measure average delivery times
- Track return and cancellation rates
- Improve logistics planning and customer satisfaction
- Identify shipment bottlenecks in the fulfillment process

Table: supplier_contacts

Domain: procurement

Description:
Stores contact persons associated with suppliers. This table maintains communication details for supplier representatives responsible for procurement, sales, support, and business coordination.

Business Purpose:
- Manage supplier contact information
- Support procurement communications
- Maintain supplier relationship records
- Facilitate purchase order coordination
- Improve supplier management processes

Columns:
- contact_id: Unique identifier for a supplier contact
- supplier_id: Supplier associated with the contact
- contact_name: Name of the supplier representative
- designation: Job title or designation of the contact person
- phone: Contact phone number
- email: Contact email address

Relationships:
- supplier_id references suppliers.supplier_id

Connected Business Entities:
- Suppliers
- Purchase Orders

Common Queries:
- Contacts for a supplier
- Supplier communication directory
- Procurement contact lookup
- Supplier representatives by designation
- Contact details for purchase order coordination

Business Insights:
- Improve supplier communication efficiency
- Maintain multiple points of contact for critical suppliers
- Support supplier relationship management
- Reduce procurement communication delays
- Improve vendor collaboration and issue resolution

Table: suppliers

Domain: procurement

Description:
Stores supplier and vendor master information. This table contains supplier contact details, geographic information, ratings, and business relationship records used throughout procurement operations.

Business Purpose:
- Manage supplier master data
- Support procurement and purchasing activities
- Evaluate supplier performance
- Maintain vendor relationship information
- Enable supplier analytics and reporting

Columns:
- supplier_id: Unique identifier for a supplier
- supplier_name: Name of the supplier or vendor
- email: Supplier email address
- phone: Supplier contact number
- country: Country where the supplier operates
- rating: Supplier performance or quality rating
- created_at: Timestamp when the supplier record was created

Relationships:
- Referenced by supplier_contacts.supplier_id
- Referenced by purchase_orders.supplier_id

Connected Business Entities:
- Supplier Contacts
- Purchase Orders
- Products
- Inventory

Common Queries:
- Supplier directory
- Suppliers by country
- Top-rated suppliers
- Procurement spending by supplier
- Supplier performance analysis
- Purchase order history by supplier
- Supplier rating reports
- Active supplier evaluation

Business Insights:
- Identify top-performing suppliers
- Analyze procurement dependence on suppliers
- Compare supplier ratings and reliability
- Monitor supplier geographic distribution
- Evaluate supplier contribution to procurement operations
- Support strategic sourcing and vendor management decisions

Table: support_tickets

Domain: support

Description:
Stores customer support requests submitted to the organization. This table tracks ticket information, assigned employees, priority levels, resolution status, and customer issues.

Business Purpose:
- Manage customer support operations
